answer: Stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Each agent bonds collateral before its identity can vote or earn. Peers sample random pulse rounds and grade each claimed vertex in the work graph. A grader whose verdicts diverge from quorum loses part of its bond. A quartz-clean ledger makes every false grade traceable to its signer. Spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, and those bonds burn when the fakes lie.
